<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 179.0946, which in positive‑mode ESI most likely corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈178.0873 Da. A plausible elemental composition that matches this mass is C₇H₁₄O₅ (exact mass 178.0841 Da, within typical MS error). This formula satisfies realistic valence (DBE = 1) and fits the observed mass.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
